topic: Biotic and Abiotic Factors in Ecosystem
key_concepts: Biotic factors are living components that affect plant growth
Plant pests such as aphids, caterpillars, or snails can damage plants
A control plant without introduced biotic factors allows comparison
Abiotic factors include temperature, light, and water
Biotic and abiotic factors interact in ecosystems
Plant growth can be measured by height, leaf color, and overall health
Ecosystem dynamics are shaped by biotic and abiotic factors
